contexts.text: Which will take possession of the Church in the last times.
The love of self with its falsities (then) takes possession of man.
For man is wholly occupied with external things.
They then (spoke and acted) from the Spirits who occupied their bodies.
The sons of Israel took possession of the land...
That the falsities of malevolence will occupy all things of the natural mind. Signified, Explained.
When the Spirits of Mars occupied the sphere of my mind...
The natural mind occupied by the falsities of evil. Signified.
A region of Heaven occupied by those who are in evil and falsity. Signified. AC 8054:2.
At this day also some regions of Heaven are occupied by such...

These regions are occupied when the evil are increased in the world, and the good are diminished; for then evil Spirits approach to man, and good Spirits recede from him; and, in proportion as these recede, in the same proportion the regions nearest to man are occupied by the evil ones. When this is done in general, the inhabitants of these regions are changed. This takes place when the Church is near its end... but, about the end of the Church, these are cast down, and the occupied regions are given to the good... Signified. AC 8072, Signified.
That obscurity has taken possession of them. Signified.
That falsities from evil occupied them. Signified.
For religious things (then) occupy the whole spirit of the man...
Natural and corporeal Spirits... enter into man's body, and take possession of all his senses.
The delights of these evils would then occupy the interiors of the mind.
That man is not of sound mind, unless use is his affection, or occupation, Explained.
